code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate rectangular hollow frames by matching solid horizontal and vertical sides.
    frames=[]
    for r1 in range(h):
      for r2 in range(r1+2,h):
       for c1 in range(w):
        for c2 in range(c1+2,w):
         col=g[r1][c1]
         if col==0: continue
         if all(g[r1][c]==col and g[r2][c]==col for c in range(c1,c2+1)) and all(g[r][c1]==col and g[r][c2]==col for r in range(r1,r2+1)):
          frames.append((r1,r2,c1,c2,col))
    # Keep maximal frame candidates.
    frames=[f for f in frames if not any(f!=q and q[0]<=f[0] and q[1]>=f[1] and q[2]<=f[2] and q[3]>=f[3] for q in frames)]
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (0,5) and x not in [f[4] for f in frames])
    # Rare isolated signal colors correspond in order of frequency to the frames.
    signals=sorted(counts, key=lambda x:counts[x])
    frames=sorted(frames,key=lambda f:f[0])
    for i,(r1,r2,c1,c2,edge) in enumerate(frames):
      if i>=len(signals): continue
      color=signals[i]
      for r in range(r1+1,r2):
       for c in range(c1+1,c2):
        if (r-r1-1+c-c1-1)%2==1: g[r][c]=color
        else: g[r][c]=0
    return g
'''
